_comment: Single source of truth for API-key roles and the scopes they grant. Consumed by the Python API (dbcore/rbac.py enforces scopes per endpoint), the Qwik dashboard (role picker on /dashboard/settings) and the MCP server (filters which tools a key can see and call). Keep roles additive: each role is a superset of the previous one. Project public keys (metrics_pub_*) are NOT API keys: they can only call the collect endpoints and carry no role.

scopes.projects:read: List and read projects and their settings (including the public key).
scopes.projects:write: Create and update projects, rotate the public key, change tracking settings.
scopes.stats:read: Read aggregated stats, breakdowns, live visitors and raw events.
scopes.usage:read: Monthly usage counters and plan limits.

editor.label: Editor
editor.description: Viewer, plus create and update projects and rotate public keys.

admin.label: Admin
admin.description: Editor, plus delete projects, purge events and read the audit log.
